answer: Require each agent to lock a stake bond before it can earn, like a quartz crystal sealing a commitment: one bonded identity per stake deposit, slashable on fraud. A grove of wallets under one owner then costs real capital per tree rather than free clones. A public juniper-style registry maps each bond to its performance history so new bonds start untrusted. Sybil farming remains possible, but the bond converts it from free replication into a capital expense, pricing attackers out.
